purpose: Every sound SquatchSmash needs. All cues are procedural WebAudio today; these ids are the brief for produced audio, and the drop-in points once it exists.

conventions.format: 48 kHz mono WAV for one-shots, 48 kHz stereo for music and ambience loops
conventions.naming: audio/<scene>/<category>/<file>[_NN].wav — NN is the variation index, 01-based
conventions.loops: entries marked loop:true must be seamless
conventions.status: todo | recorded | in-game — update as assets land

sfx.description: Three heavy sasquatch knuckles on a hollow motel door.
Cheap door opening on a dry hinge, chain rattling.
Door slammed hard enough to move the frame.
Deadbolt thrown, then the chain. The sound of a deal changing.
Door leaving its frame with a body attached (Room Service).
Bathroom window sliding open an inch and stopping.
Fist into a torso. Close, wet, unglamorous.
Full sasquatch swing connecting. Deeper, with a wooden crack.
A heavy arm moving through humid air and hitting nothing.
A grown seller going down onto motel carpet.
Compact revolver in a small room: crack, then the room slapping back.
Enemy pistol, thinner and further away.
Hammer on an empty chamber.
Commercial meat slicer spinning up in a bathroom. Never reassuring.
Stun prod arcing — dry electrical snap.
Cleaver through air, ending in a chop into furniture.
Two heavy bodies wrestling, fabric and breath.
A jar of classified seasoning thrown into somebody's eyes.
Shower curtain and rod coming down over a man.
Somebody catching the sealer cord and hitting the floor.
Motel window going out onto concrete.
Shards settling ten seconds after the smash.
Cheap table or railing giving up.
Air-conditioning unit or car meeting the ground.
A 1997 television taking a man and dying loudly.
Ceiling fan overspeeding and spitting sparks.
Motel sign shorting out — bang, then the hum stops.
Vacuum-sealed foil being turned over in big hands.
Somebody chewing evidence.
One deliberate bite of the Reserve. The last sound of the scene.
A cured strip bent until the outer edge cracks.
Suitcase latches popping, lid lifting.
A numbered wax seal broken off a package.
Vacuum-sealed contraband meeting an open flame. Plastic first, then meat.
The counter sealer running a bag: pump, heat, click.
Television volume going up on nothing in particular.
Ice machine dropping a load of cubes at the worst moment.
Motel plumbing: a faucet running, then stopping too suddenly.
A knife tapping a laminate table, unhurried.
Uneven ceiling fan clicking once per rotation.
Air-conditioning unit dripping onto the walkway.
Vending machine compressor kicking in.
The clerk's under-counter alarm. Cheap, insistent, effective.
Tired sedan turning over twice before it catches.
Tyres on warm asphalt leaving a motel lot.
A siren somewhere else, getting interested.
The same siren, no longer somewhere else.
Heavy car door opening and shutting.
The second car idling in the lot with nobody in it.
Two cars trading paint at speed.
Sasquatch foot on cracked motel concrete.
Same foot on thin motel carpet.
Same foot on bathroom tile.
Same foot crossing the parking lot.
Same foot on the painted floor of a drained pool.
Exterior staircase taking more weight than it was built for.
Landing from the balcony or into the deep end.
Crawling through a wet drainage tunnel.
Per-line subtitle tick. Very quiet, very short.
Dialogue option chosen.
Objective updated.
Achievement unlocked — brass, brief, pleased with itself.
End-of-scene sting: minor, humid, unresolved.
Sasquatch double-fist slam into a structure.
Non-final hit: wood and panel cracking.
Arms through open air.
Fist meets boulder. Rock wins.
Both feet down: a shockwave with dirt in it.
A camper ceasing to be a camper.
Car or RV going up.
Heavy footfall on pine needles and dirt.
Panicked camper doppler-ing away.
The roar. Chest, gravel, and a little bit of grief.
Beehive alumni looking for someone to blame.
Tranquiliser rifle: compressed air, no bang.
Dart finding fur.
Golden cooler: seconds added to the clock.
Power-up collected.
A Squatch Smash goal completes: brief, bright, and readable over the rampage.
Final frenzy alarm: everything is worth double.
End-of-run sting.
A ranger captain takes a full sasquatch hit without losing the fight.
The ranger captain finally drops: armour, body, and a short victory accent.

ambience.description: Buzzing pink motel sign. Mains hum with a thin harmonic on top.
A wall air-conditioner running badly, with a loose panel.
Distant road, insects, warm wind through palms.
Inside room twelve: fan, television murmur, plumbing, nobody breathing normally.
Muffled late-night television through a wall.
Down in the drained pool: enclosed, dead, dripping.
Rear alley: extractor fan, dumpster metal ticking as it cools.
The suspicion bed. A low pulse that speeds up as the room turns.
Campground afternoon: birds, wind in pines, a distant generator.

music.description: Under the deal: minimal, humid, two notes and a lot of patience.
The room goes: fast percussion, brass stabs, distorted guitar, clave. Original — no film score.
The getaway: same band, faster, driving bass, siren-shaped topline.
Scene one groove: four-on-the-floor, square bass riff, sparse lead.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Room twelve. The jerky deal is our cover until daylight. Meat first. Money second.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: That is how business works.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Good. Business. Not opera.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: If they waste my time, they lose more than jerky.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Buy. Leave. No speeches.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: This motel smells like boiled carpet.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: The pool. Nobody drained it since the eighties.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: If the grain runs sideways, we walk.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Grain runs sideways, I am driving.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: You Prospect?

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: You Rico?

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Depends who is asking about meat at this hour.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Open the door.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Relax, big man. Doors open easier when nobody yells at them.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: No, I am motel inspection.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Funny. Inspectors do not have that much fur.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Depends what is in the suitcase.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: What is in the suitcase is history. Come inside before the neighbours smell it.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Mountain reserve. Eleven-year cure. No fillers.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: This smoke is real.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: I did not say the meat was real.

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: You buying or writing a cookbook?

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Show me the full case.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: The whole case. Nothing to hide in a case.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Do not rush me near meat.

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: Nobody is rushing. I am just standing here. By the door.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: I have eaten belts with better texture.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Belts. He says belts. In my room.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: This was cut against the grain. Who handled it?

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Nobody handled it. It handles itself.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: This is gas-station product with the logo scraped off.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Bring out the real case and we forget this.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: There is no other case. There is this case.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: You sold me a lie in a wrapper. Fix it.

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: Rico. He knows.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Eleven-year cure. It has a barcode from last April.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Barcodes get printed. Meat gets born.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Sugar glaze, uniform strips, no butcher stamp. Room eleven, then.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: ...Who told you about eleven?

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Your driver takes forty of your money for parking a car. Walk out with me instead. You keep the case, I keep the cash, he keeps the parking.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Snow stays. Say the next part carefully.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: The next part is the part where you decide.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Say his name again and I use the vacuum sealer on you.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Noted. Loudly.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: You are the third best liar in this room and there are three of us.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Three. He counted three.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: A man with real product does not need a partner. Deal.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Now that is business.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Tell me that was worth it.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: It is real.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Then we are rich. I am still shaking.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Drive before I inspect you.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Driving. Driving.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: You parked facing the building.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: I parked facing the exit. Mostly.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Humidity touched the bottom packages.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Humidity touched everything tonight.

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Do not touch that package.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: That batch crossed three state lines.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: You think rare meat grows on trees?
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: The cattle had names.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: This is not gas-station product.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: No refunds once you chew.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: Stand where I can see you.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: Rico. Why is he so tall. Rico.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: In this room we are all the same size.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Do not lean on that. It is a wall, but only technically.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Seventy-two hours of smoke. Seventy-two.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: The gloves are for hygiene.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Government took the herd. Government did not take everything.
voice.context: ambient seller bark in room twelve

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: I can smell preservatives.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: This room is too warm.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: You stored this near fish.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Nobody locks a door during honest jerky.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: You people do not respect the cure.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: This strip has been folded.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Silver is cheaper than this and silver does not spoil.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: I have to duck in your doorway. Think about what that means for you.

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Everyone in this room is smaller than the deal.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Buy it and leave. I said no speeches, and I can see one forming.
voice.context: ambient Snow bark in the lot

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Second car. Running. Nobody in it.
voice.context: ambient Snow bark in the lot

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: The upstairs. Somebody keeps not looking at me.
voice.context: ambient Snow bark in the lot

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Two minutes. Then I honk.
voice.context: ambient Snow bark in the lot

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: One package? Ask for the case.
voice.context: ambient Snow bark in the lot

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Bring out the cutting board!

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: Get the case! Get the case!

voice.speaker: Bathroom Seller
voice.line: Hold him still!

voice.speaker: Rico
voice.line: Not the product! Anything but the product!

voice.speaker: Chino
voice.line: He is too big! Somebody find the prod!

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Which case is ours?

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Coming in. Do not swing.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Car is running! Move!

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Pool side!

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: We wait for daylight. Once your block is clean, I put you home. Now show me what survived.

voice.speaker: Snow
voice.line: Well?

voice.speaker: Prospect
voice.line: Too much pepper.
